01-upload-call.ts.description: Call to CRM (project 8): form where a rep uploads a sales call recording for a deal; shows the summary, CRM updates and a review link when processing ends.

02-process-call.ts.description: Call to CRM (project 8): transcribes the call with speaker labels, analyses it (GPT-5.4), applies safe CRM updates and queues the rest and the follow-up email for review.

03-crm.ts.description: Call to CRM (project 8): CRM adapter. Reads deals and writes notes, tasks and deal fields in HubSpot (live) or the Tidewater tables (test).

04-review-page.ts.description: Call to CRM (project 8): the rep's review page for a processed call, and the endpoint that applies approved changes and sends the follow-up email.

05-send-email.ts.description: Call to CRM (project 8): sends an email with Gmail in live mode or writes it to the Tidewater Outbox table in test mode.

06-reset-demo.ts.description: Call to CRM (project 8): puts the demo CRM back to its starting deals, companies and contacts and clears calls, activity and the outbox.

07-make-demo-calls.ts.description: Call to CRM (project 8): makes the three demo sales call recordings with OpenAI text-to-speech.
